subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should final-answer candidate lifecycle land as this separate Control UI Activity slice, or should it be folded into the broader native Codex progress work tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039?
rationale: The code path is product-visible, the canonical issue is explicitly marked as needing maintainer/product review, and the branch now needs a non-trivial rebase onto the current Activity architecture.

options.title: Rebase and review as a narrow slice
options.body: Have the contributor or a maintainer port the answer-candidate handling into the current Activity modules and review it as a bounded part of the broader native Codex progress UX.

options.title: Fold into the canonical progress work
options.body: Keep this PR open only as source material and implement answer-candidate visibility inside the eventual https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80039 solution.

options.title: Decline the separate surface
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers decide final-answer candidates should not be shown as standalone Activity entries.

recommendation.title: Rebase and review as a narrow slice
recommendation.body: Have the contributor or a maintainer port the answer-candidate handling into the current Activity modules and review it as a bounded part of the broader native Codex progress UX.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of both the Codex projector and the restructured Control UI Activity path makes this the best available routing owner.
